brief: docs/briefs/52-kat-pi-agent.md, Phase B step 4 feasibility: can mlx-lm LoRA train KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev OptiQ (mixed 4/8-bit) on whole pi sessions in 32 GB?
machine: M1 Max 32 GB, user's normal apps open (swap 13-15 GB in use), mem_guard limit 29.5 GiB
data: one real pi request from the KAT toy probe (system + tools + 16 messages), rendered exactly as mlx_lm.server renders it (process_message_content, enable_thinking false); padded in a tool result to the target length. Served prompt is a prefix of the training render (checked).

runs.name: L1-16k-refused
runs.result: refused by preflight: largest fitting row at L=1 is 14208 tokens

runs.name: L4
runs.result: refused by preflight: largest fitting row at L=4 is 480 tokens (adapted GDN backward ~7 MiB/token, docs/finetune/MEMORY_MODEL.md)

runs.name: nogdn-L4
runs.keys: self_attn + shared_expert only (GDN frozen, FROZEN_GDN_KERNEL=1), preflight off
runs.result: Metal OOM on the first training step

runs.name: nogdn-L4-4k
runs.result: Metal OOM on the first training step

verdict: Trainable only as a 1-layer LoRA (last layer, full attention, 0.25M parameters) on sessions up to ~14k tokens. Every 4-layer variant fails, even at 4k tokens. The one earlier 1-layer RFT on this architecture (Qwen3.6, results/20261106T011305Z-rft-base-k8) made the model worse. A home-made pi adapter for KAT is technically possible but very low capacity on this Mac; not recommended without more memory (e.g. closing apps, or a larger machine).
